scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node copy-public.mjs dist
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.cache/test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node copy-public.mjs .cache/test/src && node --test .cache/test/test/*.test.js
